flags.note: The construct שֵׁמוֹת של is unusual; standard Hebrew would use construct state שְׁמוֹת חֵירוּפִים וְגִדּוּפִים.
Should be construct state לַחַבּוּרַת מָוֶת rather than the analytical שֶׁל construction.
Hebrew would naturally use construct state זְמַן אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים rather than the analytical שֶׁל.
Standard Hebrew would use construct state בְּסֵפֶר חַיֵּי הַשֶּׂה rather than the analytical שֶׁל construction.
Hebrew would naturally use construct state אֹתוֹתָיו וּמוֹפְתָיו rather than the analytical שֶׁלּוֹ.

flags.hebrew: השם של החיה או המספר של שמו
flags.note: Standard Hebrew would use construct states שֵׁם הַחַיָּה and מִסְפַּר שְׁמוֹ rather than the analytical שֶׁל constructions.
Hebrew would naturally use construct state מִסְפַּר אָדָם אֶחָד rather than the analytical שֶׁל construction.
